title: Huly product window
description: A dark app window drawn from divs: icon rail, sidebar, issue board with status columns and task cards, and an inbox panel. It scales as one piece, so phones see the whole window in miniature. Glowing top edge, fades out at the bottom.
notes: always dark: adds the dark class to itself
scales with its container width (container query units); give it the width you want
name: huly-window

props.name: logo
props.description: mark shown in the app tile at the top of the rail

props.name: widget
props.description: small stat widget under the app tile

props.name: sidebar
props.type: { title: string; search: string; items: string[]; groupLabel?: string | undefined; groups?: string[] | undefined; }

props.name: people
props.description: initials shown at the top right of the board

props.name: views
props.description: view tabs; the first is active

props.name: inbox
props.type: { title: string; tabs: string[]; badge?: string; items: { name: string; action: string; target?: string; time: string; place: string; unread?: boolean | undefined; }[]; } | undefined
